blocks.text: Mastering the Zoom interface on macOS

Your screen is your workspace. When you lead an onboarding session, you need to share your screen, show product workflows, and keep an eye on your notes. On a Mac, this means managing windows effectively. Use Mission Control by swiping up with three fingers to organize your apps. Keep your Zoom window on one side and your CRM or demo environment on the other.

System permissions are the most common cause of meeting delays. macOS requires explicit permission for Zoom to use your camera and microphone. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera and ensure Zoom is toggled on. Do the same for Microphone. If you ever have a black screen during a share, check these settings first.
Essential Zoom keyboard shortcuts for specialists

items: ⌘ + ⇧ + A: Mute or unmute your audio.
⌘ + ⇧ + V: Start or stop your video.
⌘ + ⇧ + S: Start or stop screen sharing.
⌘ + ⇧ + H: Show or hide the meeting chat.

blocks.text: Memorizing these shortcuts saves you from hunting for buttons while your customer is watching. It keeps the flow of your onboarding session smooth. If you forget one, you can ask Lazur to point at the menu item for you.

You spend 40% of your time on admin work. Much of this happens after the call. Use your meeting notes to draft follow-up emails immediately. Instead of typing everything from scratch, use text expansion or dictate your notes while the details are fresh. Lazur helps you dictate clean text directly into your email client or CRM.
Create a standard template for your onboarding summary emails. When you finish a call, dictate the specific customer details into the template using Lazur to save time.

blocks.text: Setting up your environment for success

Your lighting and audio quality reflect your professionalism. A simple ring light behind your monitor makes a difference. Use a dedicated microphone if your built-in Mac microphone picks up too much room noise. Test your setup by recording a short meeting with yourself before your first client call of the day.

faq.question: How do I fix a black screen when sharing my screen in Zoom on Mac?
faq.answer: This is usually a permissions issue. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording and ensure Zoom is enabled. You may need to restart Zoom for the changes to take effect.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to control Zoom buttons?
faq.answer: Lazur does not click buttons for you. However, you can ask Lazur to point at a button so you can see exactly where it is, or ask it to explain how to perform a task in Zoom.

faq.question: How do I improve my Mac performance during Zoom calls?
faq.answer: Close unnecessary background applications, keep your macOS updated, and ensure you are not running resource-heavy tasks while in a meeting. Using a wired internet connection instead of Wi-Fi also helps.
